name: Blue throw
notes: One blue woven throw hangs over the upper railing, with its cream fringe included. It shares the rail with a separate cream cloth; the crop preserves the actual fabric and fringe instead of masking individual threads.

name: Brass mister
notes: The small brass plant mister sits deep on the upper shelf beside trailing greenery. The outline follows its reservoir, two finger loops and vertical pump; loop interiors are excluded. A separate dark stem on the wall to its left is not part of the target.

name: Blue lidded tin
notes: A small blue-and-white lidded tin is tucked below the ribbon rack. The hanging cream ribbon overlaps its left side; the lid knob, rim, cylindrical body and painted decoration remain visible in the unchanged source crop.

name: Flower picture
notes: The lower framed botanical picture on the right wall contains one pink flower and green leaves. The whole wooden frame is included; the upper landscape painting is separate.
